desc: A CLOAK CLASP of bronze shaped like a round sun with two spread wings, with a fan of real brown, white and grey FEATHERS attached behind it, displayed upright on a tiny wooden stand. an ancient sacred relic of the first ten humans, small, weathered and very old, seen from the high three-quarter top-down game camera, standing upright on its own (no stand, no table, no ground) as it would sit on a small offering tray.
